changeSet.author: pc
changeSet.comment: Fix issue #278: roster rows saved before the CanonicalFormConverter fix may still have @umail.ucsb.edu emails (in any case) instead of the canonical @ucsb.edu form. Rewrite them in place. The email is lowercased before REPLACE is applied (rather than after) so the match is deterministic regardless of a given database engine's default case-sensitivity for string comparisons - see CanonicalizeUmailEmailsMigrationTests. Idempotent since the WHERE clause only matches rows that would actually change.

sql.sql: UPDATE student SET email = REPLACE(LOWER(email), '@umail.ucsb.edu', '@ucsb.edu') WHERE email <> REPLACE(LOWER(email), '@umail.ucsb.edu', '@ucsb.edu');

changeSet.author: pc
changeSet.comment: Fix issue #278: same canonicalization as above, applied to the staff table.

sql.sql: UPDATE staff SET email = REPLACE(LOWER(email), '@umail.ucsb.edu', '@ucsb.edu') WHERE email <> REPLACE(LOWER(email), '@umail.ucsb.edu', '@ucsb.edu');
